run_multi_turn_question: run the multi_turn_question sgl.function with a question and get assistant answers
run_batch_requests: run a batch of multi_turn_question requests and collect all response states
stream_function_output: stream the multi_turn_question function output token by token
set_anthropic_backend: set the default sgl backend to Anthropic with claude-3-haiku-20240307
get_state_messages: get the conversation messages from a multi_turn_question run state
